metadata.summary: Dataset of 1,204 abdominal and thoracic CT images with manual segmentations of 104 anatomical structures, including organs, bones, muscles, and vessels, retrospectively collected at the University Hospital Basel.
metadata.purpose: Intended as a benchmark and pretraining resource for medical image segmentation.

papers.title: TotalSegmentator: Robust segmentation of 104 anatomical structures in CT images

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified; no protected health information retained.
ethics.legal_compliance: Compliant with Swiss data protection law (necessity of waiver confirmed by local IRB).

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Single-center origin limits geographic and demographic diversity.
Limited to abdominal and thoracic CT scans; not representative of head, extremity, or pediatric CT.
No reported age, sex, or ethnicity distribution.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ from single Swiss academic center; unknown demographic composition.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic metadata (age, sex, ethnicity) not provided.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Retrospectively collected abdominal and thoracic CT images.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing abdominal and thoracic CT imaging at University Hospital Basel.

annotation.annotation_method: Manual segmentations by experts of 104 anatomical structures.
